description: Election Commission - Declare that M. R. M. Nausad as a member of the Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mawanella Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member ceasing to belong to their political party. The content specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and details the process for nominating a new member. This falls directly under electoral processes and local authority member declarations, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
